raw_block.rationale: Create two small statutory comparison helpers for recurring binary questions. Each separates current factual and proposition fields from one coupled current-source rule read, applies exceptions before comparing the proposition with the legally determined result, and returns the native Entailment/Contradiction labels without memorizing either training answer.

inputs.name: tax_year
inputs.question: What tax year does the current fact pattern and proposition concern?

inputs.name: deduction_allowable_to_another_taxpayer
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that a section 151 deduction for this individual is allowable to another taxpayer for the relevant calendar year?

inputs.name: proposition_exemption_amount
inputs.question: What dollar exemption amount does the current proposition assert for the individual?

skill.intent: Classify a stated personal-exemption amount by applying the current section 151 amount, dependent-disallowance, and special-year rules.

outputs.description: Entailment if the asserted amount equals the amount determined by the current section; otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: general_exemption_amount

origin.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the term "exemption amount" means $2,000.

premises.question: What general exemption amount does the current section specify?

premises.name: dependent_disallowed_amount

origin.quote: the exemption amount applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall be zero.

premises.question: What amount applies when a deduction for the individual is allowable to another taxpayer?

premises.name: special_zero_start_year

origin.quote: In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term "exemption amount" means zero.

premises.question: What is the first taxable-year start year covered by the current special zero-amount rule?

premises.name: special_zero_end_year

origin.quote: In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term "exemption amount" means zero.

premises.question: What is the last taxable-year start year covered by the current special zero-amount rule?

fields.name: general_exemption_amount
fields.question: What is the ordinary exemption amount in dollars?

fields.name: dependent_disallowed_amount
fields.question: What amount applies to an individual deductible by another taxpayer?

fields.name: special_zero_start_year
fields.question: What is the first covered taxable-year start year for the special zero rule?

fields.name: special_zero_end_year
fields.question: What is the last covered taxable-year start year for the special zero rule?

reads.question: From the current section 151 source, jointly read the ordinary exemption amount, the amount imposed when another taxpayer may deduct the individual, and the inclusive taxable-year range for any special zero-amount rule.

origin.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the term "exemption amount" means $2,000.

source_obligations.statement: Determine whether a dependent-disallowance or special-year zero rule replaces the ordinary exemption amount before comparing the proposition.

origin.quote: Under section 151(d)(2), Bob's exemption amount for the year 2015 is equal to $2000.

source_obligations.statement: Return Entailment only when the proposition's amount equals the amount produced by the applicable current rule; otherwise return Contradiction.

source_provenance.quote: In the case of an individual with respect to whom a deduction under this section is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins, the exemption amount applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall be zero.

inputs.name: is_agricultural_labor
inputs.question: Was the current payment made for agricultural labor?

inputs.name: payment_is_cash
inputs.question: Was the current remuneration paid in cash rather than in another medium?

inputs.name: proposition_says_included_as_wages
inputs.question: Does the current proposition assert that section 3306(b)'s wages definition includes the payment?

skill.intent: Classify whether a current payment is included as wages under section 3306(b), applying the noncash agricultural-labor exclusion.

outputs.description: Entailment if the proposition matches the payment's inclusion status under section 3306(b); otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: general_non_cash_remuneration_included

origin.quote: the term "wages" means all remuneration for employment, including the cash value of all remuneration (including benefits) paid in any medium other than cash

premises.question: Does the current wages definition generally include the cash value of remuneration paid in a medium other than cash?

premises.name: non_cash_agricultural_remuneration_excluded

origin.quote: (11) remuneration for agricultural labor paid in any medium other than cash;

premises.question: Does the current section expressly exclude noncash remuneration for agricultural labor from wages?

fields.name: general_non_cash_remuneration_included
fields.question: Does the general wages definition include the cash value of noncash remuneration?

fields.name: non_cash_agricultural_remuneration_excluded
fields.question: Is remuneration for agricultural labor paid other than in cash excluded?

reads.question: From the current section 3306(b), jointly determine whether noncash remuneration is generally included in wages and whether noncash remuneration for agricultural labor is expressly excluded.
reads.source_locator: Current source_text section 3306(b), including its general definition and enumerated exclusions.

origin.quote: except that such term shall not include-

source_obligations.statement: Apply the express noncash agricultural-labor exclusion after the general inclusion of noncash remuneration.

origin.quote: Section 3306(b) applies to the payment in hay made by Alice to Bob for the year 2018.

source_obligations.statement: Return Entailment when the proposition matches the payment's inclusion status and Contradiction when it asserts the opposite.
